# nestegg / fuzz

nestegg's own fuzz target `fuzz` ([source](source/fuzz.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over nestegg (kinetiknz/nestegg at 1c9936b1).

Checks one property, an API contract: nestegg_read_packet contract: when it returns <= 0 (end of stream or error) it must not hand back a packet (pkt stays NULL).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against nestegg at commit 1c9936b1.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- nestegg_read_packet contract: when it returns <= 0 (end of stream or error) it must not hand back a packet (pkt stays NULL) ([lines 154-156](source/fuzz.cc#L154-L156)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch nestegg` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz.plain` | 85,216 | `f222f1e48d8b4871574b378ed42e9ca07ee1425b45ccde72184d40001f82a6e1` |
| ubsan | `fuzz.ubsan` | 89,192 | `5ceee14e0cb69711b20416992166f3c991768ac613aabad0a4660127fb24f09e` |
| asan | `fuzz.asan` | 831,288 | `402c7fba87ad01f48359f2354bcdd8e157dad5db8b3e351a02c0036059215569` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz.asan-ubsan` | 828,664 | `351538f80b0bf1adad55b16012cfed70880268d65c4068923762f42efb754a82` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
